g.text: FoodLink AI — Activity Diagram: Food Donation Lifecycle
"Pickup deadline is already in the past"
Pickup deadline still in the future?
The donation stays open to every
Leave the donation in the open pool
Bind the recipient to the donation
An organisation accepts before the deadline?
See the pickup in the unclaimed queue
Collect the food from the donor
Hand the food over at the kitchen
The owning donor, or an administrator, may move a donation to
CANCELLED from AVAILABLE, MATCHED, ACCEPTED, VOLUNTEER_ASSIGNED
or PICKED_UP. CANCELLED is terminal. Implemented and tested in
the API; not yet offered by the web portal.
Every StatusEvent above is stamped by the server, never by the
client. GET /api/metrics derives median time-to-claim, median
handover time, rescue rate and expiry-loss rate from exactly
